dateWindow.purpose: Purposive clinical relevance reference set, including dated references; not a current-acquisition recall sample.

selectionRule: Before inspecting repository outcomes for these IDs, choose four primary original research reports, four official society/multisociety normative documents and four clinical narrative reviews from public PubMed/journal/society sources. Cover five ER/ICU topic areas. Prefer decisions with concrete bedside consequences and include a narrow but practical ICU review. Accessible source discovery is a convenience constraint; no exhaustive search or random sampling is claimed.
splitRule: Freeze two cases per track for development and two per track for holdout before code changes or repository outcome lookup. Development includes both dated and current examples; holdout is not balanced for age. Do not tune code from holdout identities/labels before patch freeze.
independenceLimits: Earlier audit exposed other repository candidates; previously known cases are controls only.
Source-first selection is independent of these cases' current repository outcomes, not independent of general clinical knowledge or author judgment.
Twelve positive relevance labels cannot estimate overall selection precision or literature recall.
Dated cases outside configured acquisition windows are reference controls within the clinical-quality set, not evidence of current search omission.

cases.title: Noninvasive Ventilation for Preoxygenation during Emergency Intubation

judgment.evidence: Multicenter randomized trial; procedural hypoxemia outcome, not proof of improved long-term survival.
judgment.clinicalRationale: NIV versus oxygen mask before emergency intubation; directly actionable airway preparation.
judgment.recency: Judge acquisition-window eligibility separately; relevance does not imply current automatic admission.
judgment.editionFamily: Primary PREOXI report; exclude correspondence and later commentary.
judgment.uncertainty: Purposive expert judgment, not a validated gold standard. Abstract/metadata-level review unless the source note states otherwise; no automatic adoption or treatment recommendation.

cases.title: Antibiotic Treatment for 7 versus 14 Days in Patients with Bloodstream Infections

judgment.evidence: Randomized noninferiority trial; interpret prespecified exclusions and noninferiority margin before generalization.
judgment.clinicalRationale: Antibiotic duration in hospitalized bloodstream infection is a common ICU stewardship decision.
judgment.recency: Judge acquisition-window eligibility separately; relevance does not imply current automatic admission.
judgment.editionFamily: Primary BALANCE report; online publication 2024-11-20 predates print.
judgment.uncertainty: Purposive expert judgment, not a validated gold standard. Abstract/metadata-level review unless the source note states otherwise; no automatic adoption or treatment recommendation.

cases.title: Liberal or Restrictive Transfusion Strategy in Patients with Traumatic Brain Injury

judgment.evidence: Randomized trial; six-month unfavorable neurologic outcome difference was not statistically significant; confidence interval does not establish equivalence.
judgment.clinicalRationale: Hemoglobin threshold in moderate/severe TBI addresses a consequential ICU choice.
judgment.recency: Judge acquisition-window eligibility separately; relevance does not imply current automatic admission.
judgment.editionFamily: Primary HEMOTION report; online publication 2024-06-13; secondary analyses are not a replacement edition.
judgment.uncertainty: Purposive expert judgment, not a validated gold standard. Abstract/metadata-level review unless the source note states otherwise; no automatic adoption or treatment recommendation.

cases.title: Personalized Hemodynamic Resuscitation Targeting Capillary Refill Time in Early Septic Shock: The ANDROMEDA-SHOCK-2 Randomized Clinical Trial

judgment.evidence: Multicenter randomized trial; hierarchical composite win ratio 1.16 (95% CI 1.02–1.33) is not a stand-alone mortality benefit.
judgment.clinicalRationale: Early septic-shock resuscitation and bedside perfusion targets are directly relevant.
judgment.recency: Judge acquisition-window eligibility separately; relevance does not imply current automatic admission.
judgment.editionFamily: Primary JAMA randomized trial, 2025 volume 334 issue 22; print date 2025-12-09. Exact online date not verified; do not rely on an invented online day.
judgment.uncertainty: Purposive expert judgment, not a validated gold standard. Abstract/metadata-level review unless the source note states otherwise; no automatic adoption or treatment recommendation.

cases.title: Hyperglycemic Crises in Adults With Diabetes: A Consensus Report

judgment.evidence: Multisociety expert consensus, not a new randomized trial; individual recommendations require their own certainty assessment.
judgment.clinicalRationale: Adult DKA/HHS recognition and treatment have immediate ER/ICU applicability.
judgment.recency: Judge acquisition-window eligibility separately; relevance does not imply current automatic admission.
judgment.editionFamily: 2024 consensus revision; parallel journal versions should be grouped rather than counted as independent recommendations.
judgment.uncertainty: Purposive expert judgment, not a validated gold standard. Abstract/metadata-level review unless the source note states otherwise; no automatic adoption or treatment recommendation.

cases.title: Guidelines for Seizure Prophylaxis in Adults Hospitalized with Moderate-Severe Traumatic Brain Injury: A Clinical Practice Guideline for Health Care Professionals from the Neurocritical Care Society

judgment.evidence: Society guideline based on systematic review; strength/certainty must remain separate from clinical relevance.
judgment.clinicalRationale: Whether, which and how long to use prophylactic antiseizure medication after TBI is a concrete ICU decision.
judgment.recency: Judge acquisition-window eligibility separately; relevance does not imply current automatic admission.
judgment.editionFamily: 2024 NCS guideline; online 2024-02-05. June issue date has no verified day.
judgment.uncertainty: Purposive expert judgment, not a validated gold standard. Abstract/metadata-level review unless the source note states otherwise; no automatic adoption or treatment recommendation.

cases.title: Infectious Diseases Society of America 2026 Guidance on the Treatment of Antimicrobial-Resistant Gram-Negative Infections

judgment.evidence: Expert guidance informed by literature and consensus; explicitly not GRADE, with US epidemiology and drug availability limitations.
judgment.clinicalRationale: Resistant-organism antibiotic selection is directly useful to ICU care, with local susceptibility and formulary adaptation.
judgment.recency: Judge acquisition-window eligibility separately; relevance does not imply current automatic admission.
judgment.editionFamily: Explicitly replaces earlier IDSA AMR guidance; evidence current through 2026-03-01, typeset correction 2026-08-26.
judgment.uncertainty: Purposive expert judgment, not a validated gold standard. Abstract/metadata-level review unless the source note states otherwise; no automatic adoption or treatment recommendation.

knownBoundaryControls.label: PADIS focused update belongs to guideline consideration; observed review reservoir is not a search miss.
Ketamine co-publications are one recommendation family, not newer versus superseded editions.
ARDS main guideline and executive summary are one family with distinct document roles.
Narrow ICU hematologic-emergency review has plausible clinical relevance; held fit judgment needs context, not automatic promotion.

currentWindowStratum.note: Only the five in-window cases enter a current-window descriptive denominator; neither stratum estimates recall.

freezeProtocol: Final source-first freeze follows clarification to separate current-window and dated strata. An unpublished pre-freeze draft was revised for these strata and date precision; no repository outcome lookup or code edits occurred before final freeze.
